declarations.description: Draws a browser window, phone, tablet or laptop around its content, for product shots and live previews on marketing pages and in docs. The content is the screen: an image or a video covers it, and live markup lays out inside it. A `` is sized to the screen, but its inner `` is the page's to size (`width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover`), since the frame's styles cannot reach it. The frame is decorative: it adds no role, and the browser's window dots are hidden from assistive technology. Describe the content itself (an image's `alt`, a `role="img"` label) when it is a picture of a product.
